result.title: ART-MPG: Autoregressive R/T Manifold Path Guiding
result.summary: Specular chains concentrate important transport in small regions of path space and the structure depends on chain topology. We introduce ART-MPG, a compact neural model that samples chain length, an autoregressive reflection/transmission (R/T) string, and a direction from a topology-conditioned four-component von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mixture. We extend the repeated trial weighting in Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) by conditioning retry sampling on both chain length and the sampled R/T string, accounting for its known mass outside the stochastic re-hit trials. For a fixed proposal and target chain, this preserves the ideal expectation while reducing the expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance compared with retries conditioned on chain length alone. We distinguish the formal unbiasedness result from the capped and clamped renderer used in experiments. We evaluate fourteen scenes across a range of samples per pixel (SPP) against existing online and offline rendering algorithms. Our method consistently produces lower mean squared error at equal SPP than the online and offline baselines, with lower standard deviation across runs.

AI.brief_summary: ART-MPG 是一个面向镜面链的紧凑神经路径引导模型：自回归地采样链长与反射/透射（R/T）串，再以该拓扑为条件从四分量 vMF 混合分布中采样方向；它把 Manifold Path Guiding 的重试加权扩展为同时以链长与 R/T 串为条件的重试，以降低重试次数和倒数估计器方差，并在十四个场景上与在线、离线渲染基线比较 MSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散结构自回归生成 + 以完整结构为条件的重采样与方差缩减」可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中按推理子轨迹分配贡献、重采样 latent 状态，以及无偏估计与截断实现之间的差距如何对应 latent 轨迹训练中的监督可靠性。
